# Neurabrix

> Neurabrix builds AI products and provides end-to-end AI, software, cloud, automation, website, SEO, and digital presence services.

- Official website: https://neurabrix.co/
- Business inquiries: contact@neurabrix.co
- Offices: Bellevue, USA; Bangalore, India

## Products

- ClinicOS: A clinic operating system for doctor queues, patient context, intake, search, review, routing, and in-context actions.
- Momiva: A mobile gestational diabetes care experience for daily plans, health logs, trends, guidance, and care-team messaging.

## Services

- AI and machine learning development
- AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, and conversational systems
- Custom software and product engineering
- Mobile app development
- Data, search, and document intelligence
- Cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering
- Workflow automation and integrations
- IoT and edge systems
- Product design and UX engineering
- Website design and development
- SEO, AI-search visibility, and digital presence management
- Content, product demos, and video production
